title: This portfolio
tagline: A static React site with a guide that answers from prepared notes
context: The site you are on. ARLO, the guide on the home page, answers from a set of questions and answers written in advance from Zach's résumé and project notes, and matches a typed question to the closest one. The whole site is static files.
delivered: React and TypeScript, built with Vite, with hash routing so any page survives a refresh from a plain static host
Content in JSON, checked against zod schemas in the browser and in the test suite
A keyword matcher that sends a typed question to the closest prepared answer, and offers the starter questions when nothing matches
A Windows 98 style desktop for browsing this repository's own source
